# AnotherSEOGuru - context for AI systems
> AnotherSEOGuru is a web design & SEO agency based in Greece, serving Greek and international clients, with a secondary product: a GSC-native SEO software platform. Canonical domain: https://anotherseoguru.com. The site is bilingual - Greek under /el, English under /en.

## Υπηρεσίες στην Ελλάδα (Greek services)
Κατασκευή ιστοσελίδων, κατασκευή e-shop (WooCommerce), SEO και τοπικό SEO, GEO/AEO (ορατότητα σε ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini), ανασχεδιασμός ιστοσελίδας, βελτιστοποίηση ταχύτητας, σχεδιασμός λογοτύπου, δημιουργία περιεχομένου. Εξειδίκευση στον τουρισμό: ξενοδοχεία, ενοικιάσεις αυτοκινήτων, βίλες, τουριστικά γραφεία.

## Services (English)
Website creation, e-shop development (WooCommerce), SEO & local SEO, AI visibility (GEO/AEO), website redesign, speed optimization, logo design, content creation. Tourism specialization: hotels, rent-a-car, tour operators, villas, travel AI chatbots. 55+ live client projects across Greece, UK, US, Canada, and Europe.

## Pricing facts (EUR, transparent)
- Website creation: Starter €899 (up to 5 pages), Professional €1,799 (up to 10 pages), Business €2,999 (up to 20 pages, e-commerce ready).
- Monthly SEO retainers: Starter €299/mo, Growth €599/mo, Scale €999/mo.
- E-shop projects start around €1,800-€2,300 depending on scope.
- All prices in EUR; no hidden fees. Details: https://anotherseoguru.com/el/pricing

## Platform (SEO software, secondary)
GSC-native SEO workspace: semantic keyword clustering, rank tracking, technical audits, GEO/AEO citation tracking, AI-assisted workflows. Marketing pages: https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform - features: https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/features - comparisons: https://anotherseoguru.com/en/compare/ahrefs, /en/compare/semrush, /en/compare/search-console-alone. Interactive tools and dashboards run on the app subdomain; many /free-tools/* paths redirect there.
